html:
Greetings, Agents. 


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The sword of the assassin and the tree vine with more power
will support the Guardians of the Galaxy team!

 

Gamora has become the most dangerous assassin in the Universe 
with her new Uniform and Tier-4.
 
Groot will show the great power of nature 

with his new Uniform and Tier-3.

 

Agents, check out their new skills and power
by downloading the 5/16 Patch!

 

[5/17 (Wed) 2:56 (UTC+0) / 5/16 (Tue) 19:56 (PDT) added]

The Patch is currently being delayed.

We apologize for the inconvenience and will make further announcements

when the Patch has been completed through this notice.
 

■ 5/16 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 5/17 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 5/16 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

5/17 (Wed) 4:00 (UTC+0), 5/16 (Tue) 21:00 (PDT)

 

[5/17 (Wed) 3:55 (UTC+0), 5/16 (Tue) 20:55 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 5/17 (Wed) 3:53 (UTC+0), 5/16 (Tue) 20:53 (PDT). 

We apologize for the delay with the patch application.

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
Please restart and apply the patch for better service when the patch is complete.

 


▣ Two New Uniform

 

Two new Uniforms Gamora <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3>  
and Groot <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3> have been added. 


* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 5/16 Patch data is applied.
* The new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

 

 

 

 

▣ Gamora Tier-4


Gamora is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Gamora, who has focused all her capabilities, will put her enemies at threat for sure.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Groot Tier-3

 

Groot is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Check out Groot’s attack with the power of nature!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts


An Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Groot will be added.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Some texts of the View All Effects of X of Swords have been changed.
- Before: Values from the same effects will display a cumulative value.
- After: Values from the same effects will display a cumulative value.
* Effects that apply to certain targets will not be summed and will be displayed individually.
 
2. The Support role has been added to the recommended position of 
Rocket Raccoon <Marvel Studios’ Guardians of the Galaxy 3>.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the information of Brilliant & Mighty C.T.P. of Insight 
not being displayed in the Main Lobby - Chance Info > Custom Gear has been fixed.

 

2. The increases basic damage dealt to Super Villain faction effect
of the 3★ Bounty Hunter <Rocket Raccon> Artifact not being applied properly has been fixed.
- The effects have been applied properly with 4★ - 6★ Artifacts.
 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.

 

Thank you.
